    • hashCode

      public long hashCode(Object object)
      Description copied from class: BigHashMap
      Calculates the hash code of a key for this map. By default, this method returns the result of Utilities.hashCode(Object), which only generates Java int hash codes. In order to ensure constant time access when this map holds more than Integer.MAX_VALUE entries, this method needs to be overridden to return a Java long.

    • get

      public edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.State get(Object key)
      Returns the value mapped to the given key, or null if the key does not exist or maps to null.

      If the given key object is a Sabre state graph node, this method will return the corresponding story graph state object, creating it if it does not yet exist. In the returned state, each fluent in the story graph will have its value set to the story graph value that corresponds to the value from the state node for the corresponding Sabre fluent.

      Overrides:
      get in class BigHashMap<edu.uky.cs.nil.sabre.graph.StateNode, edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.State>
      Parameters:
      key - the key whose value is desired
      Returns:
      the value associated with the key, or null if the key is not mapped to a value or if the key is mapped to null
